our_takes.our-take: The DBS yuu American Express Card is best for those heavily invested in the yuu rewards ecosystem, especially if you spend over S$800 monthly. Hitting that minimum unlocks up to 18% cash rebates (or 10 miles per S$1) at participating stores like Cold Storage, Giant and BreadTalk, which significantly boosts your rebates. For general spending outside the yuu network, the base 0.25% rebate is less competitive; this card truly shines for loyal yuu partners only. Points don't expire, providing flexibility in redemption. Consider if your spending aligns strongly with yuu merchants to maximize value.
our_takes.good-for:
Cardholders who spend frequently at yuu merchants such as Cold Storage and Giant for groceries and essentials.
Perfect for individuals who want to earn significant rebates on dining, recreation, and telco expenses with eligible spend.
Ideal for users active on foodpanda, or using transportation services like Gojek, seeking rewards on everyday spending.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fee of S$196.20 applies after the first year; evaluate if card benefits justify the cost.
A 27.80% p.a. interest rate can accrue if you carry a balance, increasing debt significantly.
Late payment fees of S$100 apply for balances over S$200, so pay on time.
